reason: The dusty gas is entering the smaller knot in the same crowded lane, so the hotspot is the natural place to follow it.

choice.with: Gas crowded into the dark lane

effect: The smaller knot formed a young star surrounded by a dusty disk, completing the chapter's goals and distinguishing its outcome from the large gathering.
reaction: The contrast between a cluster and a single star with a disk was satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the dusty gas into the smaller knot was most worthwhile: it showed how material can remain in orbit rather than become part of the star.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two decisions used the same hotspot in much the same way, so the interaction was somewhat repetitive, despite their different outcomes.

surprise.text: The large gathering produced many young stars, while the smaller turning knot produced one star with a dusty disk.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary; both followed the visible descriptions of gas entering the gatherings.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see what becomes of the material left in the dusty disk, though the repeated hotspot interaction was fairly straightforward.
